senses.gloss: פַּגֵּר same, to break up, destroy; to break through.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 14:17">Targ. Is. XIV, 17</cite>.

<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 19:21">Ib. XIX, 21</cite>; <cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 19:24">24</cite>; a. fr.—Part. pass. <he>מְפַגַּר</he>; f. <cite ref="M00807"><he>מְפַגְּרָא</he></cite>; pl. <he>מְפַגְּרִין</he>, <he>מְפַגְּרֵי</he>; <he>מפַגּרָתָא</he>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Kings 18:30">Targ. I Kings XVIII, 30</cite>.

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Ezekiel 36:35">Targ. Ez. XXXVI, 35</cite>.—Pesik. Zakhor, p. 26ᵃ (expl. <he>ערו</he>, <cite ref="Psalms 137:7">Ps. CXXXVII, 7</cite>) <he>פַּגְּרוּ פַּגְּרוּ</he> destroy, destroy ye!; <cite ref="Psalms 137:7">ib.</cite> ʿĂniya, p. 135ᵃ <he>פַּגָּארוּ פַּגָּארוּ</he>; (<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 32:1">Pesik. R. s. 32</cite> <he>תברו</he>); Midr. Till. to Ps. l. c.; <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 5:1">Lam. R. to V, 1</cite>.—
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 19">Lev. R. s. 19</cite> (expl. <he>נמהרי לב</he>) <he>מפגרי לבא</he> those crushed at heart (with ref. to <he>ימהרו</he>, <cite ref="Nahum 2:6">Nah. II, 6</cite>).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Lamentations 2:8">Targ. Lam. II, 8</cite> (h. text <he>אמללו</he>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Ezekiel 30:4">Targ. Ez. XXX, 4</cite>; a. fr.
